67f711e800796d61251f3532c3a1d3416bc68452.translation: Senti medo no escuro e agarrei meu cobertor.

67f711e800796d61251f3532c3a1d3416bc68452.text: I feel scared in the dark, so I hold my blanket.
67f711e800796d61251f3532c3a1d3416bc68452.translation: 어둠 속에서는 조금 무서워서 담요를 꼭 잡는다.

67f711e800796d61251f3532c3a1d3416bc68452.text: I feel scared in the dark, so I hold my blanket.
67f711e800796d61251f3532c3a1d3416bc68452.translation: 暗くて静かだから、こわい気持ちになった。

67f711e800796d61251f3532c3a1d3416bc68452.text: I feel scared in the dark, so I hold my blanket.
